notes: Vite + TypeScript canvas shooter deployed to Cloudflare Pages. Leaderboard table public.leaderboard has RLS enabled and forced with select + insert-only policies, CHECK constraints on name (1-16 chars, restricted charset) and score (0..10000000), and a BEFORE INSERT trigger that trims the name and sets id/created_at server-side. Browser uses only the publishable key. 27 vitest unit tests plus a 3-spec Playwright suite executed against the production URL, covering a real Supabase insert, top-10 read, and persistence across reload. Migration in supabase/migrations/0001_leaderboard.sql.
